context: The isolated Codex profile and reverso route for OpenCode Go, deferred out of G4 and G6 because adding the route prefix made codex-sync fail closed for every deployment without the subscription.
root_causes: codex-sync treats every routed prefix as REQUIRED live discovery, so adding opencode made every sync fail for anyone without an OpenCode subscription.
codex_profile_default_model falls back to models[0], which for this catalog sorts to deepseek-v4-flash: an id gated behind a workspace opt in, so the profile default would 403 on first use.
A Codex profile carries its own context window, and leaving it unset makes Codex size context management from its own default rather than the model's real limit.
evidence: Adding the route prefix alone failed 83 tests with 'required reverso provider model discovery returned no compatible models for: opencode'; making discovery optional reduced that to 27.
OPTIONAL_DISCOVERY_PREFIXES already exempts ollama for the same class of reason: its daemon may simply not be running.
load_catalog_ids()[0] is deepseek-v4-flash, which returns 403 RegionError until the workspace opts in.
The install-plan group dependency lists are validated as sorted, and provider-opencode sorts AFTER provider-openai-pass-through, which the first attempt got wrong.
solutions: Add opencode to OPTIONAL_DISCOVERY_PREFIXES so a missing subscription degrades instead of failing every sync.
Pin an explicit profile default of glm-5: dual protocol, ungated and uncontested, and still fall through to models[0] when it is absent from discovery.
Derive the profile context window from the model the profile actually pins, which a single-model profile can do exactly, unlike the multi-model Claude launcher.
Complete the route, surface and shared-codex dependency wiring in both halves of each double-entry contract.
acceptance_criteria: The route prefix is registered and its discovery is optional.
The profile default is never a gated id, and falls back correctly when the explicit default is absent from discovery.
The profile routes through reverso_opencode and uses the model catalog.
The profile context window and auto-compact limit come from the pinned model's real limits.
Every catalog id stays Codex selectable, so a gated model surfaces its opt-in error rather than vanishing.
Other prefixes keep their existing defaults and windows.
The install-plan contracts agree between code and manifest.
legacy_risk_reason: changes the codex-sync required-discovery contract and the install-plan group graph shared by every provider; a regression breaks Codex profile sync for all of them
